body:
Hello everyone, Thanks for all the support. After a thorough community discussion with community moderators and people we have reduced our proposal and also edited the amount according to the market conditions.

As our proposal is on chain, We request council members that if the motion is approved by the community, we will return the edg tokens to the treasury.

Thank you  [@mrbulb](/edgeware/account/jXC7ghviUzVcVySg3eD8prB7C9m6VzK6cw2MTyMTDTUye5q) Sir for all the help in this proposal and thank you [@Shankar Warang](/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS) sir for putting this proposal on chain. 

As mentioned in the community discussions we are promising a sizeable reduction in the next milestone. We do not take this promise lightly and you should be able to see this documented in the proposal as well. We are just not sure of how much, since our videos are not pre-recorded and its difficult for us to figure out a final number yet.

Taking into account the recent market conditions and the remarks around it, you can already see a 3k USD reduction in our current proposal grant requirements. 

People have also said a few things around how this is not something that adds value to the Edgeware ecosystem but I still strongly believe in a democratised learning system that includes everyone and not just people who don't know what it's like to be differently enabled. With your support we should be able to provide help to those who don't have any other resources and are unable to access information that should be freely available in a format that works with them.

Do let me know if you have any questions around these topics. I am more than happy to dive deeper and provide an in-depth explanation.

Hey Sonal, wanted to ask a few more questions… and also maybe provide some details on our current cultural norms. 

The majority of our proposal have been post paid, meaning on-chain democracy occurs after services have been rendered. This allows the DAO citizens to have an evaluation and supports accountability for our contributors. 

A Good Faith agreement for initial funding is usually discussed with DAO members. The percentage required for development is unique to each proposal. 

**Proposal Questions**

_Regarding the price determination_

What would be expected video length for the tutorials created for this proposal?
My extrapolation based on the recent uploads of videos on your channel ..
 
Video Length Average: 2mins  

Regarding your planned content. Is it possible to have a listing of planned content... or will that be the reasonability of your content creator? 

My goal is to obtain an understanding of the Edgeware features, functionality or insights you plan to highlight.

--------------------------
Lastly, to be direct. I am in agreement with Gmeister and our overall DAO consensus about the pricing. 
I would like to gain a further understanding and overall remain interested in proposals providing support for any our current or future citizen experiencing hearing disabilities.  Looking forward to speaking you again in our community calls..

Hey @Zovern, thank you for the questions and apologies for the late response. Here are my responses:

1. We generally look at a 3 min mark since thats the max we should aim for when doing explainer videos.
2. We do have a list of videos with their description in the proposal, we will be covering those more deeply after our explainer videos.

I understand that the community feels the cost of producing these videos are high, we are working on getting these costs down in the next milestone given we can promise something long term. We'll updating our proposal to reflect those changes.

Do let me know if you have any other questions around the proposal, happy to help.
NO for me, not under current price tag for sure, not under current market conditions

Hello Sonal, 

I have seen your content, its good. But the price you are asking for is well over the worth, I see the need for these videos but we have to find the middle ground here because almost 1000$ per video is pretty much unheard. 

1) The video quality produced right now is very basic. I have seen that you will be working other community members as well, so good. But there is no graphic visuals at the moment. So there is nothing for us to base it on. There is not much video editing going on as well nor there will be any high level videography. 

2) The state of the market. The demand for crypto being very low right it would be impractical to spend this much, Even in a bull market I think the price is too high for the samples provided. So depending on the scenario, compromises should be made. 

3) Your YouTube channel has 40 subscribers right now, even though that is irrelevant for this deal it should be considered on the fact that the videos could help your channel to grow with the Edgeware content funded by Edgeware. So price should be altered again cause it benefits both the parties. 

This is how I would rate per video: 

I will consider the rate based on the quality of the video and the market, because hiring a sign language interpreter is not very costly. These videos could be made for way less. For the fact that you research about the ecosystem and will be available for taking feedback(even though it should be the norm), I believe the price should be higher than when hiring someone online. 

So for the first phase to see what your videos are all about we should be starting from the base and based on the communities reaction prices can be re-negotiated. 

For now 350$ per video is the best offer in my opinion.

**Funding request**

- 1st phase - 7 videos ~ 2450 USD(350$ per video)


- 2nd phase - 7 videos ~ 2450 USD(Re-negotiation possible depending on 1st phase)


- 3rd phase - 7 videos ~ Same as phase 2.

Hey @Gmeister, completely understand your point here. Here are the responses based on the point you mentioned.

1. I agree that the video is basic, but there are other costs that are involved in the making of these videos, since content creation for sign language comes with its own set of requirements. You can take a look at the proposal to understand our process. We are still in the process of improving by feedback and we are definitely going to the drawing board to improve the quality of videos. All each video is divided into three parts, which mean each video request is essentially equivalent to producing three videos.
2. All the cost of the video goes into freelance fee and other operational costs, so lowering the amount would mean we lose out on members who help us create these videos. 
3. We do, but us growing would not mean a lot if we don't monetize content or any look at any other sources of funding. Our channel depends completely on the funds provided by Edgeware.


Regarding your point around hiring a sign interpreter, I do agree hiring one is not costly, but hiring one who understands crypto and is willing to put their face online is an above average ask and would come with costs associated with it.

Do let me know if you have any other questions or if you want me to expand on any of these points.

1)I have gone through the proposal I have seen the requirements you have put down. But it could never be 1000USD per video.

Sign language interpreters
Conceptual content creators
Instructional designers
Visual story makers
Editors

Other than the first 2. the work of other 3 are very minimal from the videos we have seen so far.

"each video is divided into three parts, which mean each video request is essentially equivalent to producing three videos."

Completely disagree with this point. Its still one video if its on the same topic

2) I would like to see the rate of all these. Cos if it takes 1k USD to make a tutorial video it should be very high quality video with great graphic designs and animation.

Which is not there. In fact I don't see any graphics that's worth mentioning.

Also if the demand is low and supply is high the value decreases. Not just for crypto tokens but for everything that constitutes around it.
Doing business at these times means you'll have to compromise in the value.

3)That is irrelevant. What you decide to do with it is your choice but the fact remains. It benefits both parties and is a valid point for negotiation.

I don't see the need of the sign language interpreter to understand the crypto deeply rather just need to know the basics.
They are interpreting the content that you have researched.

Putting your face online, You have to hire the ones that are willing, it doesn't mean they cost more, even if they did it how much more could it be?

Like I said 350$ for 1st phase and last 2 phases can be re-negotiated depending on the 1st phase.

Or else a detailed report on the expenditure should be made. Even still it will be a tough pill to swallow.
I want this to happen. But at the right price. The price is well over the limit

Hi Sonal, Yes from me. I heard you on the call and like what you are doing and why you are doing it.

Keep it up. You are almost there.

Hey [@mrbulb](/edgeware/account/jXC7ghviUzVcVySg3eD8prB7C9m6VzK6cw2MTyMTDTUye5q) 

Thank you so much for the questions. We would definitely love to connect with James and Jamie to better understand what we should expect and see how can we improve. 

We decided to begin with mostly intro videos on crypto and web3 and then move on to basics of Edgeware and Polkadot. 

Let me know if that’s something you had in mind. Looking forward to any other thoughts you have.
